source.backup_date_note: Backup header timestamp has not been independently decoded.

operational_tables_withheld.ti_Tender: TenderUID may refer to a live auction identity; not needed for static definitions.
operational_tables_withheld.ti_OutPostNextWarTime: Live outpost war scheduling state, not a static game definition.

privacy_review.ti_InfluenceWar: Static faction/stage enums, rates, item/monster definitions and summon coordinates; no account, character or ownership IDs.
privacy_review.ti_OperatorAction: Static action type, item/function/source IDs, numeric value and action description; no admin credentials.
privacy_review.ti_ItemEvent.CheckWithCharacterUID: A BOOL validation-mode flag in AtumParam.h:2714, not a character identity. Observed values are 0/NULL.

excluded: All non-allowlisted account, credential, player and operational tables; all raw pages and SQL modules.
limitations: Read-only offline extraction, not a SQL Server RESTORE validation.
Only primary leaf rows from catalog-owned allocations are exported; ghost rows are excluded.
Each table must match its catalog row count exactly or its entire export is withheld.
Definitions retain legacy units and IDs; no current-client catalog is overwritten.
Map-object definitions are not monster spawn placements.
Native object/regional spawn placements are recovered separately in legacy_rules/native_spawns.json; they are not supplied by this static SQL table catalog.
Nullable and invalid legacy rows are preserved; consumers must validate usable IDs and fields.

anomalies.rare_probability_note: Raw backup values reach 600000; do not assume the documented 100000 rare-probability scale or normalize these values without further source reconciliation.
